details:
HealthAnalyzer — Intelligent Health Monitoring for Space Missions

HealthAnalyzer is an interactive platform designed to demonstrate how astronauts' physical and psychological well-being could be monitored during long-duration space missions.

Key Features

  • Health Dashboard — Tracks heart rate, sleep, activity, fatigue, and stress.
  • Personalized Analytics — Establishes individual health baselines and identifies unusual changes.
  • Anomaly Detection — Uses statistical methods to detect deviations from personal health patterns.
  • Multi-Indicator Analysis — Reveals relationships between different health measurements.
  • Historical Mission Replay — Simulates health monitoring over time.
  • Interactive Visualization — Presents complex health data through an intuitive space-themed interface.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, Recharts
  • Backend: Python, FastAPI
  • Database: SQLite, SQLAlchemy
  • Data Analysis: Pandas, NumPy, statistical algorithms

Dataset

The prototype uses the PMData dataset, featuring Fitbit measurements and self-reported wellness data from 16 Earth-based participants. It allows us to demonstrate the monitoring workflow without real spacecraft hardware.

Innovation & Impact

Unlike basic monitoring dashboards, HealthAnalyzer focuses on personalized analysis, detecting meaningful changes relative to individual baselines rather than relying on universal thresholds.

Its explainable anomaly detection helps identify which measurements contribute to unusual patterns, supporting more informed decisions.

Our vision is to contribute to future autonomous health monitoring systems for space exploration, where immediate medical assistance from Earth may be limited.

HealthAnalyzer is a research and demonstration prototype, not a clinically validated diagnostic system.
